tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal lha mo'i me lce 'bar ba'i gleng gzhi'i rgyud kyi bsdus don bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// dpal ldan rnal 'byor ma dpal rgyud// ḍa ki me lce phreng 'dra ba'i// 'bar ba gsal byed rgyud 'di yi// bsdus don 'di ni gsal bar dgod// dpal mkha' 'gro ma me lce 'bar ba'i rgyud 'di la gsum ste/ de la klad don mtshan phun sum 'tshogs pa dang*/ gzhung don dgos 'brel gyi don bstan pa dang*/ 'jug yongs su rdzogs pa'i bya ba'o// klad don la gnyis mtshan dngos dang*/ mchod par brjod pa'o// gzhung don la spyir le'u nyi shu rtsa nyis gnas pa la/ le'u dang po brjod bya brjod byed rnams kyi don bsdus pa/ gleng bzhi rgyas par bshad pa/ le'u bco brgyad du rgyud kyi don las phran dang bcas pa rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ 'og ma gsum gyi rjes su yid rang pa dang bcas pas bstod pa dang*/ yongs su gtad cing*/ rjes su lung bstan pa'o// dang po la gsum las/ phun sum tshogs pa lngar bsdus ste bstan pa/ des 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ dngos dang*/ mjug le'u yi mtshan no// dang po la lnga las/ dus dang gnas bstan pa dang*/ ston pa'i mtshan nyid che ba'i yon tan dang bcas pa dang*/ 'khor gyi ni mtshan nyid kyi khyad par dang*/ chos so// 'di la dang por gleng slang ba byed pa la gnyis/ zhus pa dang lan gyis le'u thams cad kyi mdor bstan dang*/ gleng gzhi'i don bstan pa'o// gong ma la gsum/ zhu ba po'i khyad par/ ston pa'i khyad par/ so so'i mdor bstan no// zhu ba po'i khyad par la gsum/ nyid kyi yon tan dang*/ ston pa la mchod pa dang*/ tshigs su bcad de zhus pa'o// ston pa'i khyad par la gsum/ ting nge 'dzin la zhugs pa dang*/ rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul bstan pa dang*/ tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa'o// so so'i mdor bstan pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan zhu ba'i tshe mchod pa dang*/ zhu ba dngos so// gleng bzhi'i don bstan pa la dgu ste/ lha mo 'di dang po 'byung pa'i rgyu bstan pa dang*/ phyag na rdo rjes ji ltar sprul pa dang*/

srin gyi chung mar ji ltar song ba'i rgyu dang*/ ma'i dmod pa bor ba dang*// srin gyi bya ba ji ltar byas shing rdzogs pa dang*/ las kyi dbang gi ji ltar skye ba blangs pa dang*/ rdzu 'phrul can du ji ltar gyur pa dang*// sangs rgyas rnams dang ji ltar mjal zhing btul te mthu rtsal can du gyur pa dang*/ ji ltar gyur ba'i gtan tshigs so// dang po la brgyad de/ lan mdor bstan te gsungs pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad de dpag bsam gyi shing gi mtshan nyid/ lha dang lha min gyi tshogs dang*/ lha min rnams kyi ji ltar smras pa dang*/ lhas lan smras pa dang*/ lha min gyis skyar te smras nas ji ltar dmag drang pa dang*/ lha rnams kyis ji ltar 'thab par brtsams pa dang*/ ji ltar g.yul bkye ba'o// gnyis pa la bcu ste/ phyag na rdo rjes dbu ma ji ltar sprul pa/ dbang phyug la byin pa dang*/ de'i dbang gis ma ha ka la dang lha mo byung ba/ ming sring gnyis la dbang bskur te mnga' gsol pa/ g.yul bkye pas lha dmag ji ltar rgyal bar byas pa/ lha mo de ri khrod ma can du ji ltar gyur pa/ dung skyong mar ji ltar gyur pa/ de'i rnam par las kyis dbang gi lha srin mo med par byas pa/ dha sha gh+ri bas ma hā de ba la rna la rtser phul bas/ re ma tis ji ltar byung pa'o/ gsum pa la bdun te/ srin po dang srin mo dang lha mo gsum gyis dung skyong ma bslu bar byas pa dang*/ slu ba'i phyir re ma ti g.yog du phul ba dang*/ bstod de ji ltar dgyes pa dang*/ yul lang ka pu rangs su lha rnams 'gro bas mas ma blta bar bsgo ba dang*/ khol mos srin mo sbran cing slu ba'i thabs byas pa dang khol mos zhus pa dang*/ lan zhal gyis bzhes pas chung mar song ba'o// bzhi pa la gnyis te/ bu mo la dmod pa bor ba dang*/ re ma ti la dmod pa bor ba'o// lnga pa lnga drug ste/ dmod pa'i dbang gi srin du gyur pa/ seng ge zla ba la sogs byung ba/ g.yog mo la dmod pa bsdigs pa/

dpon g.yog gnyis ji ltar bros pa/ rdzas kyi gtan tshigs/ rgya mtsho'i 'gram du gshin rje bsgrubs te dmod bor te ji ltar shi ba'o// drug pa la gnyis te/ rje mo ji ltar skye ba blangs pa dang*/ khol mos skye ba blangs shing las ji ltar bya ba'o// de la brgyad/ skyes ma chu srin gyi mgo can du gyur pa dang*/ re lde mgo nyag gi bu mor gyur pa dang*/ sngon gyi las kyis rje mo dran cing ji ltar bros pa dang*/ dmangs rigs mo bsad de gos snod dus byas pa dang*/ nad kyi rkyal pa ji ltar byung ba dang*/ sho dhe'u byung pa dang*/ rims nad gcad pa dang*/ de nas dpon g.yog phrad de mthu rtsal can du gyur pa'o// bdun pa la gnyis/ mkha' 'gro 'dus pa dang*/ khyo dang sbyor ba'o// brgyad pa la brgyad/ thub pa'i drung du srog snying phul ba dang/ e ka tsa ti dang*/ sa'i lha mos mchod pa phul te srin btul ba dang*/ dpal rta mgrin gyi drung du dam bcas pa dang*/ sngon gyi las dam la btags pa dang*/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal pos mchod pa dang*/ dpal phyag na rdo rjes dbang bskur zhing mnga' gsol ba dang*/ lha srin rnams kyis brgyan phul ba'o// dgu pa la gsum/ ji ltar 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan zhus pa/ de bshad pa dngos/ gtan tshigs bstan pa'o// de bshad pa la gsum/ dge ba spyad pa/ zhe sdang nas spyad pa/ dmod bor ba'o/ le'u gnyis pa la gsum las/ 'tshams sbyar ba'i tshul gyis zhus pa dang*/ lan dang*/ don dngos dang*/ mjug le'u yi dpal mtshan no// don dngos la gnyis/ slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid dang*/ slob ma'i 'o// le'u gsum pa la yang gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba'i tshul gyi zhus pa dang*/ lan dang don dngos dang*/ 'jug le'u yi mtshan no/ don dngos la gnyis/ don dam par rang bzhin med par bstan pa dang*/ sprul pa'i sku sgyu ma lta bur blta ba'o/ le'u bzhi pa 'di la yang gsum ste/ dris pa'i tshul gyis 'tshams sbyar ba/

gzhung dngos/ 'jug le'u yi mtshan no/ gzhung dngos la drug las/ dkyil 'khor rnam gsum pa bshad zhal gyis bzhes pa/ rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor/ gzugs snyan gyi dkyil 'khor/ tshon rtsi/ lha bkod cing bri ba'i thabs so// le'u lnga pa 'di la yang gsum ste/ zhus pa'i tshig gis 'tshams sbyar ba/ gzhung don dngos bstan pa/ mjug le'u yi mtshan no// rdzas dngos bstan pa la gsum/ rdzas med na mi 'grub pa dang*/ rdzas mdor bstan dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po la gsum/ phyag na rdo rje dang*/ rje mo dang*/ re ma ti'i mo/ gong ma la bdun/ bod pa dngos dang*/ brten pa dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ dam tshig bsre ba dang*/ bskul ba dang*/ mtshan ma dbab pa dang*/ gnad la 'bebs shing bzlog pa'i rdzas so// gzhan gnyis kyang go bdun po yis 'dre/ rdzas tshang ba'i yon tan no// le'u drug pa 'di la yang gsum las/ zhus pa'i tshul gyis 'tshams sbyar ba/ bri thabs dngos/ mjug le'u mtshan no// bris thabs dngos la/ bka' stsal pa'i tshul gyis dang po'i bya ba dang*/ ras tshon byin gyi rlabs pa bri thabs dngos/ spyan phye ste snying po bkod pa/ lugs ma la yang de bzhin du bstan pa'o// le'u bdun pa la yang gsum/ zhus pa'i tshul gyis 'tshams sbyar ba/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rim pa/ mjug le'u yi mtshan no// ting nge 'dzin gyi rim pa la bzhi ste/ gtso bo bskyed pa dang*/ rje mo bskyed pa dang*/ re ma ti skyed pa dang*/ 'khor nag mo 'bum skyed pa'o// rje mo skyed pa la bdun te/ rlung nag dang*/ me dang*/ thod pa'i gzhal yas khang dang*/ dri'u dang zhing dang*/ nyi zla yi gdan dang*/ sku dngos so// ri ma ti bskyed pa la bdun te/ rlung nag 'tshub ma dang*/ gzhal yas khang dang*/ thod pa dang*/ lding khang dang*/ khang pa bdun dang*/ dri'u bse'i gdan dang bcas pa dang*/ dngos skyed pa'o// le'u brgyad pa la gsum ste/ zhus pa'i tshul gyi 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/

sngags kyi don dngos dang*/ le'u yi mtshan no// sngags kyi don dngos la gsum de'i nang ste/ sngags kyi yon tan/ gtso bo'i sngags/ dpon g.yog gi sngags bshad pa'o// gtso bo gnyis ste/ ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs te gsang sngags gsungs pa/ ji ltar bya ba'i thabs so// dpon gyi sngags bshad pa la gnyis te/ sngags mdor bsdus te bshad par zhal gyi bzhes pa/ rdo rje'i gsang sngags dngos/ 'di la gnyis te/ gsang sngags bcu gcig gi don bstan pa dang*/ rnga'i sgra'o// dang po la bcu gcig ste/ srog snying dang*/ ma mo 'bum gyi snying po dang*/ spyan drang pa dang*/ gdan bting pa dang*/ gtor ma dang*/ dam tshig bstan pa dang*/ las la bskul ba dang*/ gnad nas bskul ba dang*/ dngos grub blang pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ mtshan ma ngan pa bzlog pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ rje mo dang*/ khol mo'o// rnga'i sgra la drug ste/ gcig brdungs ring po dang thung ngu dang*/ gnyis brdungs thung ba dang*/ ring dang de nas/ gnyis brdungs bzhi brdungs su 'gyur ba'i sgra dang*/ gsum brdungs kyis drug brdungs su 'gyur ba'o// le'u dgu pa la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ phyag rgya dngos le'u yi mtshan no// dang po la gnyis ste/ zhus pa dang*/ lan no// dngos la gnyis/ spyir dang po bstan pa dang*/ bye brag tu'o// 'di la gsum/ gtso mo dang*/ rje mo dang*/ re ma ti'o// rje mo la gsum/ rlung nag ni phyag rgya dang po la rlung*/ me ri'i phyag rgya dang*/ phyag mtshan no// re ma ti la khol mo bdun/ khram bam dang*/ ma mo lcag kyu dang*/ khyung gshog dang*/ thod 'phreng dang*/ thod rlon dang*/ bdud rtsi bum pa'i phyag rgya dang tri shū la'o/ le'u bcu pa la gsum/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ le'u yi gzhung dang*/ le'u yi mtshan no// dang po la gnyis/ zhus pa dang*/ lan no// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ mchod pa gsum pa spyir bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// de la gsum/

gtor ma'i mchod pa dang*/ sbyin sreg gi mchod pa dang*/ gsang ba'i mchod pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ bca' thabs dang*/ sngags bstan pa'o// gnyis pa la lnga/ me thab bca' zhing*/ bsreg rdzas bsag pa dang*/ bskyed thabs dang*/ dbul ba'i rim pa dang*/ sngags dang rjes kyi bya ba'o// gsum pa la gnyis te/ mchod pa dngos dang*/ dngos grub dam pa yin par ston pa'o// le'u bcu gcig pa dam tshig gi le'u la gsum/ zhus pa'i tshul gyis 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ dngos dang le'u yi mtshan no// dngos bzhi dang*/ lan bka' stsal pa'i tshul gyis bshad par zhal bzhes pa dang*/ dam tshig dngos dang*/ dam tshig ma bsrungs pa'i skyon/ bsrungs pa'i yon tan no// gnyis pa la gsum/ gtso bo dang*/ rje mo dang khol mo'o// gtso bo la gsum/ sku dang gtso bo/ gsung gtso bo dang*/ thugs so// gnyis pa la gsum/ sku dang*/ gsung dang*/ thugs so// khol mo la gsum/ sku dang*/ gsung dang*/ thugs so/ dam tshig ma bsrungs pa'i skyon la gsum/ gtso bo'i dang*/ rje mo'i dang*/ g.yog mo'i 'o/ dang po gsum/ zhus pa'i dang*/ bshad par zhal gyis bzhes pa dang*/ bshad pa dngos/ dngos gsum ka la sku gsungs thugs gsum gsum du shes par bya'o// yon tan la gsum/ gtso mo dang*/ rje mo dang*/ g.yog mo'o/ de dag la'ang sku gsung thugs gsum gsum du shes par bya'o// bcu gnyis pa drod tshad kyi le'u la gsum/ zhus pa'i tshul gyi 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ gzhung dngos dang*/ le'u yi mtshan no// gzhung la gnyis/ bshad par zhal gyis bzhes pa dang*/ bshad pa dngos so/ de la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// 'di la'ang bzhi ste/ nang dang*/ gsang ba dang*/ phyi dang gzhan dag gi bltas bstan pa'o// nang la drug ste/ mig /rna ba/ sna/ lce/ lus/ snying gi rtags so// phyi la gsum ste/ rab/ 'bring*/ tha ma'o// rab la lnga ste/ spyir bshad pa zhi ba'i rtags/ drag po'i rtags/ dbang gi rtags/ rgyas pa'i rtags so// gzhan dag gi bltas bstan pa la drug te/

ma mo grub nas dbang du 'dus pa/ ma 'dus pa/ ma mo 'khrugs pa'i rtags/ bar chod kyi rtags/ ltas sna tshogs pa/ gang la chags kyi mtshan nyid dang bcas pa'o// 'di la lnga te/ gang la 'khor bar bstan pa dngos dang*/ 'phral gyi ltas dngos grub blang ba dang*/ ltas ngan pa bzlog pa dang*/ don grub mi grub kyi bltas so// le'u bcu gsum pa la gsum te/ zhus pa'i tshul gyis 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ gzhung dngos dang*/ le'u yi mtshan no// gzhung dngos la gsum ste/ lan bka' stsal ba'i tshul gyis cis kyang 'grub par bstan pa dang*/ 'on kyang mi 'grub par bstan pa dang*/ de bcos pa'i thabs so// 'on kyang mi 'grub par bstan pa la'ang gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// 'di la bzhi ste/ las 'phros ma 'brel ba dang*/ bzlas brjod nyung ba dang*/ bgegs kyi bar chod dang*/ dam tshig nyams pa'o// bcos pa'i thabs la'ang lnga ste/ las 'phro la 'brel pa bcos pa/ des the tshom med par 'grub par bstan/ bsnyen pa grangs nyung pa bcos pa'i thabs/ bgegs kyi bar du gcod pa bcos pa'o// dam tshig nyams pa bcas pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ bca' bzhi/ dmigs pa/ slar bzod gsol lo/ lnga pa la bzhi ste/ dam tshig nyams pa'i skyon/ nyams pa chen po'i bskang ba/ 'bring po'i bskang ba/ tha ma bskang ba'o/ le'u bcu bzhi pa la gsum ste/ zhus pa'i tshul gyis 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ gzhung dngos dang*/ le'u yi mtshan no// gzhung dngos la lnga ste/ bka' stsal pa'i tshul gyi dpon mo'i rten rdzas/ khol mo'i rten rdzas/ nang rten gyi mtshan nyid/ gsang pa'i rten/ grub nas ji ltar bya ba'i thabs so// le'u bco lnga pa la gsum/ zhus pa'i tshul gyi 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ gzhung dngos dang*/ le'u yi mtshan no// gzhung dngos la gnyis te/ bdag sgrub pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba'o// de la gnyis te/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos bzhi'o// de la lnga ste/ dang por phyag na rdo rje'i dbang bzhi/

rje mo'i dbang bzhi/ re ma ti'i dbang bzhi bcu gnyis kyis dam tshig dbog pa/ ma mo dbab cing nang gi dbang sbyin pa'o// 'di la lnga ste/ rigs brtag cing las kyi bya ba/ dkyil 'khor dang ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par gyis dbab pa/ mchod cing dam tshig bsre ba/ slob ma la yongs su rdzogs par sbyin pa/ dbang ma thob pa yongs su gsang bar bstan pa'o// bcu drug pa la gsum ste/ zhus pa'i tshul gyi 'tshams sbyar ba// gzhung dngos dang*/ le'u yi mtshan no// gzhung la gnyis te/ dpon mo'i las dang*/ g.yog mo'i las so// dang po la gnyis te/ sbyin bsreg dang*/ las gzhan dag go /sbyin sreg la lnga ste/ lha mo grub pas gzhan grub par bstan pa/ zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang*/ dbang dang*/ drag pos bsreg pa'i las so// las gzhan dag la drug ste/ dbye ba'i las dang*/ dgug pa/ lkugs par byed pa/ smyo bar byed pa/ rengs par byed pa dang*/ mi snang bar bya ba'o/ g.yog mo'i las la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// 'di la lnga ste/ khrag nad kyis bsad pa dang*/ rims nad dbab pa/ tshad nad dbab pa/ snying rlung gis bsad pa/ thun drug gis bsad pa'o// 'di la yang gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang*// rgyas bshad do/ rgyas bshad la brgyad do// thod pa'i thun/ mda' yi thun/ rag ta'i thun/ sgong nga'i thun/ dug gi thun/ tsi ta'i thun/ thun drug gi phan no/ ltas ngan pa dbab pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ bcu bzhi 'khor lo 'god pa dang*/ las sbyor ro// mda' thun la gnyis te/ bca' bzhi dang*/ thun sngags kyi las sbyor ro// ltas ngan dbab pa la gnyis te/ mkha' 'gro dbab pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyis btang pa'o// le'u bcu bdun pa la gsum te/ zhus pa'i tshul gyis 'tshams sbyar ba dang*// gzhung dngos dang*/ le'u yi ma tshan no// gzhung la gsum te/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dngos bzhi la bzhi ste/ ling ga'i rgyu bstan pa dang*/ bdud rtsi drangs pa dang*/

mar me bsad pa dang*/ sngags bstan pa'o// le'u bco brgyad pa la gsum ste/ zhus pa'i tshul gyi 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ gzhung dngos dang*/ le'u yi mtshan no// gzhung dngos la gsum ste/ lan bka' bstsal pa'i tshul gyi 'od zer bkye ba/ thig le ye shes don dam dang*/ kun rdzob tu bshad pa/ kun rdzob kyi don rgyas par dgrol ba'o/ le'u bcu dgu pa la gsum ste/ zhus pa'i tshul gyis 'tshams sbyar ba dang*// gzhung dngos dang*/ le'u yi mtshan no// gzhung dngos la gnyis te/ lan bka' bstsal pa'i tshul gyis spros pa bskyed pa dang*/ rdzu 'phrul bcu drug bstan pa dang*/ de la gsum/ rdzas bsag pa dang*/ spyir sgrub pa dang*/ so so'i kha bsgyur ro// 'di la bcu drug ste/ dug gis ma tshugs par bya ba dang*/ chu la ma 'bying pa sgrub pa/ mkha' spyod bsgrub pa/ mngon shes bsgrub pa/ dgug pa'i sbyor ba/ mig smin sgrub pa/ rkang mgyogs sgrub pa/ mi snang ba sgrub pa/ tshe sgrub pa/ nor gyi gter sgrub pa/ ro langs sgrub pa/ nad gso ba/ bcud kyis len pa/ thog ser dbab pa/ 'byung ba'i dgras mi tshugs pa bstan pa/ byad stems bzlog pa'o// le'u nyi shu pa la gsum te/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la brgya byin gyis bstod pa dang*/ ma mo dpon g.yog la 'khor rnams kyis bstod pa dang*// le'u yi mtshan no/ le'u nyi shu rtsa gcig pa la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba'i tshul gyis phyag na rdo rjes bka' bstsal pa dang*/ ji ltar yongs su gtad pa dang*/ brgya byin gyis ji ltar yongs su blangs pa'o// bar ma la lnga ste/ 'khor rnams la bskul ba dang*/ nyid kyi yon tan dang*/ brgya byin la gtad pa dang*/ 'di bzung ba'i yon tan dang*/ gsang ba'i gnas bstan pa'o// le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa 'di la gsum ste/ brgya byin gyis zhus pa'i tshul gyis 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ lung bstan pa dngos dang*/ le'u yi mtshan no// mkha' 'gro ma me lce 'bar ba'i bsdus don gsal ba'i me long rdzogs so/// /

༈ dpal lha mo nag mo'i phyag rgya gar mchod bzhugs so// dpal lha mo rang byung gi rgyal mo la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal chen bka' sdod mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyi// gsang ba'i phyag rgya dam tshig gnyan po dang*// pho nya ma lus kun gyi phyag rgya rnams// ma lus bdag gis 'di ru brjod par bya// de la dpal ldan 'di yi phyag rgya gar mchod la gnyis las/ rgyud kyi tshig nye bstan pa dang*/ dngos so// de la dang po 'di byed pa'i dus su/ gtor ma tshul bzhin du bshams ste/ 'byung po la gtor ma byin la/ bka' bsgo ba ni/ 'byung po gang dag sa la gnas pa dang*/ mkha' la gnas dang 'byung ba la gnas dang*/ lha klu dri za mi dang mi ma yin/ de dag thams cad gtor ma 'di long la/ so so rang rang gnas su dengs par gyis/ oṃ sum bha ni sum bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gh+ri h+na gh+ri h+na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ gh+ri h+na pa ya gh+ri h+na pa ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a na ya ho/ bha ga wan/ bhir+ya ra tsa ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa lha gsum gang rung gi nga rgyal dang ldan par bya'o// de nas ting nge 'dzin gyi lha tshogs spyan drangs la bzhugs su gsol/ mchod pa phul te/ phyag rgya bya ste/ de yang phyag rgya'i don ni mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs mnyes par bya ba dang*/ 'byung po 'dul ba dang*/ de la sogs pa du ma yod do// de la rnga'i sgra mkha' 'gro ma me lce 'bar ba'i rgyud las hūṃ hūṃ zhes rnga gcig brdungs ring pa'i sgras sa 'dul te/ rdo rje gshog pa gdengs tshul du 'cham zhing lag bskor dang bcas pas/ g.yas g.yon gsum gsum bskor bya zhing*/ thams cad dbang bsdud phyag rgya dang*/ thams cad zil gyis gnon pa dang*/ dam las ma 'da'i phyag rgya dang*/ rdo rje sbrul nag rlung 'gros gyis/ sil dal 'dul bar bya'o// de nas dngos gzhi la/ yang rdo rje lang ka nag mo'i rgyud las/ 'dul bar byed pa lhag bzhi bshad de/ de yang rnga'i sgra ni rgyud las gcig brdungs thung ngu'i sgras/

hriṃ hriṃ zhes pas so// yang rgyud las/ zil gyis mnon pa rta mchog dpal// zhes bshad pas/ zhal phyag drug sku mdog dmar/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus smug zhal/ spyi gtsug rta mgo ljang khu ste/ g.yas gsum rdo rje tho ba 'dzin/ g.yon gsum rdo rje me chen po/ de ni mgrin no// yang brgyud las/ thams cad 'dul ba'i rdo rje 'dzin// zhes pas/ dpal ldan rdo rje gtum po ni/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog mthing*/ g.yas pa rdo rje g.yon sdig 'dzub/ de ni rdo rje gtum pa'o/ yang rgyud las/ 'phrin las mnga' bdag gshin rje gshed/ zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs drug pa/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal/ zhing dbang phyug dgra sta g.yas/ sdig 'dzub sgyu zhags ban dmar g.yon/ gshin rje gshed do// bsgrub mchog e ka tsa ti ni/ zhes bshad pas/ mkha' 'gro e ka tsa ti ni/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar/ g.yas na zhing chen rgyal mtshan bsnams/ g.yon na thod pa khrag bkang 'dzin/ de ltar lhag pa'i lha bzhi'o// de nas bstod pa bya ste/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ gis skur gsal zhing*/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa kyis 'khros par bskul/ oṃ yang dag gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// dpal gyi sku chen byung ba ni// dpal chen ha ya gh+ri ba'i sku// zhal ga sum phyag drug zhabs bzhi pa// g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus smug zhal// sgeg pa dpa' bo 'jigs pa dang*// rgod dang gshed dang 'jigs par byed// snying rje ngo mtshar bdag nyid can// spyi gtsug rta mgo ljang khu ni// rngog ma leb rgan me ltar 'bar// g.yas gsum rdo rje tho ba yis// dgra bgegs spyi nas 'joms par byed/ g.yon gsum rdo rje me chen gyis/ 'byung po ma lus 'dul bar byed// zhabs brdabs srid pa gsum kyang g.yo// dpal chen rta mchog dpal la bstod// srid gsum 'jigs byed drag po rdo rje'i sku// bdag dang gzhan gyi dpal gyur snying rje can// bdud las rnam rgyal ye shes lnga ldan pa// dpal ldan phyag na rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo// thugs kyi lha mchog khro rgyal chen po ni// zhal gcig phyag gnyis mthing nag ral pa can// zhal gyi mche ba rdo rje zla tshes 'dra// rin chen mar gad rigs lnga'i dbu la brgyan// khro rgyal gtum po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// hūṃ yab gcig 'phags pa'i rgyal po 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed// sku mdog mthing nag dug 'tsho 'khyil pa 'dra// zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs drug brkyang bskum bzhugs// g.yas dkar g.yon dmar brjid pa dbus mthing zhal// zhing dbang phyug dgra sta ral gri g.yas na bsnams// sdig 'dzub sgyu zhags ban dmar mdung thung g.yon// glang chen ko rlon dur khrod chas kyis brgyan/

'gro ba'i don mdzad khro rgyal phyag 'tshal bstod// dus sum sangs rgyas skyed pa'i yum gcig ma// e ka tsa ti ghu ha ral gcig ma// dbu la gcig srid gsum zil gyis mnon/ dpral na mig gcig thams cad sa le gzigs// zhal nas so gcig skye shi rtsad nas gcod// brang na nu gcig rnal 'byor sri'u bso// lag na phur gcig dgra snying phur gyis 'debs// dbang phyug chen mo 'jig rten 'dul ba'i gtso// rnal 'byor dbang phyug ral gcig ma bstod/ da ni dpal ldan lha mo chen mo la/ de yang mkha' 'gro me lce 'bar ba'i rgyud las/ rnga'i sgra bshad pa ni/ ḍa ki ḍa ki zhes bshad pas de gnyis gar brdungs ste/ phyag rgya yang rgyud de nyid las bshad pas/ byang shar 'tshams nas spyan drang zhing*// gnyis med bzhugs su gsol ba nyid// gsum pa phyag 'tshal de nas ni// dang po rlung nag 'tshub ma nyid// me rlung smug nag 'tshub ma nyid// de nas gtso mo'i phyag rgya ni// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog mthing*// g.yas na ral dri g.yon thod khrag/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug nyid kyi'o// de na dpal ldan re ma ti/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi sku mdog mthing*/ kha ṭ+waṃ kha dang phur pa g.yas// 'phrul gyi me long sa sbrul zhags g.yon/ de ni sa gsum dbang phyug go /blon mo ba lam 'dre sna ma// mthing kha rgyal mtshan thod pa 'dzin// khri sman ldems drug ma mo ni/ mthing kha zhing dbang phyug thod khrag bsnams// de ni blon mo rnam gnyis so// bh+yo rlung nag 'tshub ma dgu klong 'khyil pa'i dbus/ pho brang gzhal yas thod pa'i sku khang nas// ma gcig dpal ldan lha mo chen mo ni// srin po nag po'i chung ma ral pa can// gsang ba'i lha mo bong zhon dbang phyug ma// zhal nas zla ba bzhed pas mun pa sel// rngam pa'i tshul gyis thod khrag dmar la rol// skye ba rnams bzhi sgrol ba'i don ston ma// khyod ni nag mo 'bum gyi dbus na bzhugs// dbang phyug kun gyi gtso mo 'bar ma ste// khyod ni khro mo kun gyi sprul pa yin// nges par bdag gi don rnams grub par mdzod// dbang phyug dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma ti// ya mtshan lus la til mar sngon pos byugs// bdud kyi yum la gshin rje'i lcam gcig ma// rdo rje dbang phyug lha mo khyod la bstod// gzhan yang dpal ldan bka' sdod blon mo ni// ba lam gre sna khri sman so bya zhon// gdug pa 'dul phyir drag po'i cha lugs rdzogs// byang chub sems ma gtum mo ma mo la// gdung pa'i yid kyis gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod/

de nas sku gsung thugs gyi sprul pa gsum gyi phyag rgya ni/ rdo rje lang ka nag mo'i rgyud las/ re ma ti/ re ma dza/ re ma dzu/ re ma dza re ma dzu gsum gshegs/ rnga ni/ me lce 'bar ba'i las/ bh+ruṃ hūṃ geṃ/ bh+ruṃ hūṃ geṃ/ bh+ruṃ hūṃ geṃ/ zhes bshad pas gsum brdungs so// phyag rgya ni/ thug gyi sprul pa re ma ti/ sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum pa/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar dbus mthing las// ral dri gri gug zhags pa g.yas// rtse gsum kha ṭaṃ zhags pa g.yon// de nas bdud mo re ma dzu// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog mthing*// g.yas pa gri gug g.yon thod khrag /de nas srin mo re ma dza// zhal gcig gnyis sku mdog dmar// zangs ral thod pa khrag bkang 'dzin// de rnams ni sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa rnams gsum mo// de la thod pa nag po'i rgyud las/ grul bum gyi rgyal pos bstod pa ni/ don dam gnyis med byang chub sems yin kyang*// srid gsum 'dul phyir rtags kyi phyag rgya ni// rang sems rnam dag drag po'i gzhal yas khang*/ rag ta khrag gi rba klong 'khyil pa la// keng rus thod 'phreng zhing gi brgyan gyis rgyan// sku mdog mthing nag rab 'jigs khro mo'i rgyal// srin po ral pa rdzings pa'i sprul pa 'gyed// sku yi sprul pa dpal ldan re ma dzu// gru gsum ser nag zhal gyi dbyings nas bzhengs// yon tan rgyas mdzad ser mo kha la bzhad// 'phrin las rgyas pa thams cad nye mdzod// gsung gi sprul pa dpal ldan re ma ti// gru gsum dmar nag zhal gyi dbyings nas bzhengs/ dmar mo chen mo dmar chen gtum mo ste// dbang gi 'phrin las thams cad grub par mdzod// thugs kyi sprul pa dpal ldan re ma dzā// gru gsum sngo skya zhal gyi dbyings nas bzhengs// dkar mo chen mo zhi ba pho nya ste/ zhi ba'i 'phrin las thams cad grub mdzod// sku gsung thugs ldan sprul pa rgya mtsho ma/

dregs pa 'joms mdzad bdud dpung zil gyis mnon// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal nas kyang*// 'gro drug sgrol mdzad sems can kun gyi ma// dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas mdzad ma// bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlobs// ces bstod do// de yan chad kyis lhag pa'i lha bzhi/ dpal mkha' 'gro ma sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa dang bcas pa'o// 'di man chad du he ru ka'i gal po dang*/ 'jigs las 'das pa'i mdo tshig go /da ni mkha' 'gro ma me lce 'bar ba'i rgyud las bshad pa/ dbang phyug ma la/ phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i dus su/ dbu rgyan la ke ri ma chen mo brgyad bzhag pa'i phyag rgya ni// ke ri ban dmar zhi dbang phyug sngo// tso ri mda' gzhu 'gengs ma ser// pra mo chu srin rgyal mtshan dmar// be ta byis za rdo 'chang nag /pu ka dmar ser zhing rgyu 'dren// kasma dung dmar dkrugs mthung ljang*// rmang sha mthing nag byis snying za// tsan dan ser skya mchog lus 'brel// gzhan yang dbang bskur ba'i dus su/ skya stod kyi brgyan du sing dang ma brgyad phul ba ni 'di'i/ sing nga kha ro snol ser seng*// khri rnal ma blta bsnol mor stag /srig ldag nag mo byis ldag wa/ sho na dral lta mthing kha spyang*// kri ta gri dmar rgyu mgo rgod// kang ka rkang phrag snar mgo ring*/ kha kha kha ro ban gri nag /hu lu lcags kyu mthing tshogs 'ug zhes bya ba ni sing nga brgyad kyi'o// bcu drug po 'di'i rnga skad ni/ me lce 'bar ba'i rgyud las/ hūṃ druṃ/ hūṃ druṃ/ hūṃ druṃ/ hūṃ druṃ/ zhes bshad pas bzhi brdungs su shes par bya'o// de nas dbang phyug chen mo'i 'khor/ dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi phyag rgya ni 'di lta ste/ shar gyi dbang phyug ma bdun/ srin mo nag thod rlon 'chang*// tshangs pa dmar ser pad+ma bsnams// lha chen dkar ljang tri shu la// rtogs 'dod sngon mo 'khor lo 'chang*// gzhon nu dmar mo mdung thung 'phen// brgya byin dkar mo in tra gdengs// rdo rje nag mo lcags kyu 'dzin// lha'i dbang phyug ma bdun ni// rdo rje ser mo tsan dan 'thung*// bdud rtsi dmar mo pad ma bsnams// zla ba dkar mo pun dha ri// be con ljang nag dbyug to 'phyar// srin mo dmar mo dung khrag 'thung*// za ba ljang nag ba su 'dren// rdo rje se mo ra mgo zhags// nub kyi dbang phyug ma bdun ni// dga' ba dmar mo ke tar 'chang*// stobs chen dkar mo bshol 'dzin ma// rdo rje ser mo spu gri gcod// 'dod pa dmar mo mda' gzhu 'gengs// nor bsrungs dkar mo bum pa 'dzin// rlung lha sngon mo ba dan 'char// rdo rje dmar mo lcags sgrog sdom// byang gi dbang phyug ma bdun ni// bsod byed dmar mo ral gri so// mi mo dmar mo gsal shing 'chang*// phag mo nag mo mche zhags can// dga' byed dmar mo zhing chung za// rna cha dkar mo thod khrag 'thung*// chu lha sngon mo sbrul zhags 'dzin// rdo rje ljang nag dril 'khrol dgyes/

'di rnams ni dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi phyag rgya ste/ rnga skad ni mkha' 'gro me lce 'bar ba'i rgyud las gsum brdungs drug brdungs kyi sgrar 'gro ba gcig bshad kyang*/ 'di la ni/ bdun brdungs kyi sgra 'di 'thad de/ rnga skad ni don ltar du shes par bya'o// de nas rdo rje gar gyi dbang phyug sring mo brgyad ni/ dbang phyug ma chen mo'i 'khor yin pas/ de'i phyag rgya ni 'di ste/ lha mo chen mo nam gru ma// mthing kha glog gi 'phreng ba thogs// rkang ldog nag mo rkang ldag ma// kha 'bar nag mo me lce 'khyer// dur byed nag mo byis snying za// lo ma can ni shing lo za// tsa mun ti ni thod khrag gtor// nam mkha'i lha mo mda' gzhu 'gengs// glog ma sprin ni thog mda' 'phen// de ni rdo rje gar gyi dbang phyug sring mo brgyad de/ rnga ni me lce 'bar ma las/ phaṭa ṭa ka zhes bshad pas gsum brdungs pa/ de nas sgo ma bzhi dang/ dmag gi rgyal mo bzhi dang*/ pho nya ma bzhi dang*/ bcu gnyis kyi phyag rgya ni/ rta gdong sngon mo lcags kyu 'dzin// phag gdong nag mo mche zhags can// nyin zla lcags me 'bar ma// thal byed dri 'khrol sna tshogs mdog /shar phyogs dmag gi rgyal mo ni// dri za chen mo brjid pa mo// zhal gcig phyag drug sku mdog dkar// zor skyogs thod mda' ba dan g.yas// sdig 'dzub thun zor g.yon pa'o// lho phyogs dmag gi rgyal mo ni// ser mo tshe dang yungs dkar 'phen// nub phyogs dmag gi rgyal mo ni// g.yang bzhi gon zhing ru mtshon 'char// byang phyogs dmag gi rgyal mo ni// rma bya'i thul pa lus la gon// g.yas na ba dan sta re bsnams// thun khrag thod pa phyag na bsnams// de nas pho nya bzhi po ni/ a phyi mi snying thod khrag 'dzin// grub ting ser mo zhags pa 'dzin// dmar 'gyogs bsod pa'i khram shing bsnams// srog bdag chen mo gri thod 'dzin// rnga ni drug brdungs gi sgrar shes par bya'o// de nas rjes kyi bya ba dgra bgegs gdug pa can 'dul ba'i stangs stangs ni gnyis brdungs thung ngu'i 'cham zhing lag bskor dang bcas pas/

hom khung bca' zhing ling ga bri// dgug dang sgral dang spar bar bya// bya rog rgyal po'i stangs stabs kyis// gcig brdungs ring po byas nas ni// 'phur ldebs lhan gsum bskor byas pas// tsham rngam lan gsum bya ba dang*// rol pa'i stangs stabs rnam par bya ba// gdab cing spang bar bya ba'o// 'di dag gi bar du bstod pa la sogs pa bya ba rnams dang*/ lag len bzhin du shes par bya'o// dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pa'i phyag rgya gar mchod/ gsal ba'i me long zhes bgyi ba/ sngags 'chang rang byung rdo rje'i yis bkod pa'o// bkra shis par gyur cig /dbang phyug chen mo 'khor dang bcas pa'o/// /'tshams 'di la don rnams pa gsum ste/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes so// dang po la gnyis/ 'byung po la gtor ma byin nas bka' bsgo ba dang*/ sa 'dul ba'o// 'di la gnyis te/ rkang stabs dang lag stabs so// de yang sngon 'di 'tshol dgos pas gcig brdungs thung ngu'i sgra la 'di ltar bya ste/ rdo rje gshogs pa gdengs tshul du 'cham zhing lag bskor dang bcas pas/ g.yas g.yon 'khyog gsum bya ba dang*/ mdun du rgu gsum bya ba dang*/ rgyab du dgyes gsum bya ba dang*/ sgeg pa'i tshul du shes par bya/ de nas gcig brdungs rings por bsgyur te/ lcag kyu dang*/ khyung gshog dang zil gnon gyi phyag rgya gsum mo// rkang pa rdo rje 'gros kyis bya zhing*/ byin du sbrul nag gi 'gros bya zhing*/ phyag rgya bsgyur ba'i dus su thams cad sgor sgor du phyin pas rlung nag 'tshub mar 'gyur ba yin no// de dag ni sngon 'gro'o// dngos bzhi la gnyis te/ phyag dang zhes pa'i 'cham po dang*/ lha'i phyag rgya'o// phyag dang zhes pa'i 'cham po la gnyis las/ de yang 'di skad du/ spyan drang bzhugs su gsol ba dang*// gus pa'i tshul gyis phyag gsum bya// bsnun gri gzhan dag mi ldang par// gom pa gnyis po la byas te// g.yas g.yon gnyis kyis bskor byas shing*// rims kyis langs ste sbrul 'gros su/

zhes bya bas phyag la sogs pa rim pa dang*/ 'grel stabs gnyis su shes par bya'o// lha'i phyag rgya bzhi ste/ lhag pa'i lha bzhi'i 'cham po dang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro rnams kyi 'cham po dang*/ dbang rtags kyi 'cham po dang*/ pho nya'i 'cham po dang bzhi'o// dang po la lnga ste/ dbang du bsdud pa rta mchog gi phyag rgya dang*/ 'dul bar byed pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ 'phrin las mnga' bdag gshin rje gshed kyi phyag rgya/ e ka tsa ti'i phyag rgya dang*/ de dag gi bstod pa'o// ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro'i 'cham po la gnyis te/ dpon g.yog bzhi'i phyag rgya bstod pa dang bcas pa dang*/ sprul pa gsum gyi phyag rgya bstod pa dang bcas pa'o// dang po la bzhi ste/ rje ma dbang phyug ma'i dang*/ 'khor re ma ti'i dang*/ blon mo gnyis dang bcas pa'o// sprul pa'i phyag rgya la gsum te/ thugs kyi sprul pa'i dang*/ bdud mo chen mo'i dang*/ srin mo 'jigs byed do// dbang rtags la gnyis te/ dbu rgyan ke re mo chen mo brgyad kyi phyag rgya dang*/ sku bstod kyi rgyan sing ha ma chen mo brgyad kyi phyag rgya'o// pho nya'i 'cham po la lnga ste/ dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi dang*/ rdo rje gar gyi dbang phyug ma sring mo brgyad kyi phyag rgya dang*/ sgo ma bzhi'i phyag rgya dang*/ dmag gi rgyal mo bzhi'i phyag rgya dang*/ pho nya bzhi'i phyag rgya'o// rjes la lnga ste/ 'brub khung bca' ba dang*/ dgug pa dang*/ sgral ba dang*/ spar ba dang*/ rol ba'o// da ni rnga skad kyi don ni 'di lta ste/ rnga skad ni sngags yin te/ de yang sngags ni spyan 'dren par gsungs ste/ zhes bshad pas/ sa 'dul gyi gcig brdungs ring po ni hūṃ ring po/ hūṃ ni rdo rje'i tshig te/ sus kyang 'dab bar mi nus so// lhag pa'i lha bzhi'i rnga skad gcig brdungs thung ngu ni hriḥste/ rta mchog gi gsung ngo*// ma mo bzhi'i rnga skad ni/

ha ki zhes pa gnyis brdungs thung ngu ste/ byon cig /bzhugs cig mdzod gcig /ces bya ba la sogs pa'o// sprul pa gsum gyi rnga skad ni/ bh+ruṃ hūṃ geṃ zhes pa ste/ gsum brdungs so// de ni sku gsungs thugs zhes pa 'am/ dngos grub gsol zhes bya ba'o// ke ri tsi ri'i rnga skad ni hūm̐ trum̐/ hūm̐ truṃ/ zhes bzhi brdungs te/ mkha' 'gro ma tsho dngos grub gsol cig /dgra bgegs sgrol cig ces bya ba la sogs pa'o// dbang phyug ma nyi shu brgyad kyi rnga skad ni rgyud las ma bshad kyang*/ re re la re re sbyar te/ gcig gnyis gsum bzhi/ lnga drug bya/ zhes pa dang*/ dbang phyug ma chen mo mkha' 'gro tsho// bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ ces pa'o// sring mo brgyad la sogs pa'i rnga skad ni/ phaṭa ṭa ka phaṭa ṭa ka zhes pa ste/ gsum brdungs skad che chung gnyis byas pas drug brdungs su 'gyur ba ste/ dgra bgegs tsho sod mdzod cig zhes bya'o// rjes kyi rnga skad ni/ ma ra ma ra/ zhes pa ste/ sod sod cig zhes pa'o// thams cad kyi rjes su gcig gcig zhes pa drug brtsegs te skad che ba gcig brdungs pa lan gsum byas 'phro bcad pa ni/ rigs drug chos kyi dbyings su spar te/ lhag ma med par bya'o/// //// /
